verdict.rationale: Cerebras Inference is an inference API. The pack documents no product-level automation, scheduling or autonomous background agent feature. The Batch API runs one-off asynchronous request groups, not recurring or autonomous automations, and tool calling is a developer building block that apps use to construct agents. Neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
